# infoblox_next_available_reserved_block (Data Source)

Retrieves the next available Reserved Block addresses from the specified parent Federated Block, without allocating them. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Prerequisites: a Federated Realm and a parent Federated Block to preview allocations from
resource "infoblox_federated_realm" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name = "example_federated_realm"
  }
}

resource "infoblox_federated_block" "example" {
  uddi = {
    address         = "10.0.0.0"
    cidr            = 16
    federated_realm = infoblox_federated_realm.example.id
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// Preview the next available reserved block addresses under a parent Federated Block.
// This does not allocate anything.
data "infoblox_next_available_reserved_block" "example_next_available_reserved_block" {
  id                   = infoblox_federated_block.example.id
  cidr                 = 24
  reserved_block_count = 3
}

// Preview the next available reserved block addresses under the Federated Blocks matching a tag
data "infoblox_next_available_reserved_block" "example_next_available_reserved_block_by_tag" {
  depends_on           = [infoblox_federated_block.example]
  cidr                 = 24
  reserved_block_count = 2
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the reserved blocks to be allocated.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The description for the reserved block. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Block.
- `name` (String) The name to be provided.
- `reserved_block_count` (Number) The count of reserved blocks required. Defaults to 1 if not set.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Key-value pairs to filter the candidate parent Federated Blocks by tags.

### Read-Only

- `results` (List of String) List of next available reserved block addresses in the specified parent Federated Block.
